page.overview:
Who is Agapos the Eighth?

Agapos the Eighth was a male ruler of the Sunesi. While popular among his subjects, history would show him to be largely ineffective—it was during his tenure that the Galactic Empire managed to establish a hold on Monor II. When the heir to the throne showed latent Force talents, Agapos the Eighth stepped down and retired in seclusion.
